For example, certain age groups or education levels can be unique. Sex can also narrow down the possibilities. On the other hand, industry decreases the risk, meaning it does not give away much information about the person.

To lower the risk, better anonymization is needed for age, education, sex, and marital_status. For age, using broader age ranges could help. For education, using general categories instead of specific degrees could work. For sex, removing this information or using a non-binary option could reduce risk. Finally, marital_status could be grouped into fewer categories. 

Risk scores represent ML model confidence under simulated attack conditions, not real-world re-identification probability.
